en.html:
Ichijou"Yes."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Chief... what is this about?"
Ichijou"Let me explain."
Kageaki"Ichijou..."
Ichijou"Yesterday, he asked for my help. To fight and bring peace back to Yamato."
Ichijou"I've decided. I'll do it."
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"Minato sir. Please."
Ichijou"Help me with this."

en.html:
By now even Ichijou must know. Most likely the Chief had told her.

If I fought and killed someone as my enemy... I would also have to kill one of my allies.

今は一条とて知っている筈だ。
　おそらく、署長が話したのだろうが。

　戦い、誰かを敵として殺したなら……
　味方の誰かをも殺さねばならない。

en.html:
My strength, only.
I would not have to kill.

No more—
No more taking an innocent person, somebody who was not even my enemy, and killing them with these hands.

With these hands.
That killing would no longer be required of me.

も済む。

　この手で。
　殺さずに、済む。
